options.name: Acid Splash
options.benefit: Add Acid Splash to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a cantrip. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. Orb deals 1d3 acid damage.

options.name: Bleed
options.benefit: Add Bleed to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a cantrip. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. Cause a stabilized creature to resume dying.

options.name: Daze
options.benefit: Add Daze to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a cantrip. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. Humanoid creature of 4 HD or less loses next action.

options.name: Mage Hand
options.benefit: Add Mage Hand to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a cantrip. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. Telekinetically move a small unattended object.

options.name: Open/Close
options.benefit: Add Open/Close to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a cantrip. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. Opens or closes small or light things.

options.name: Ray of Frost
options.benefit: Add Ray of Frost to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a cantrip. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. Fire a ray that deals cold damage.

options.name: Charm Person
options.benefit: Add Charm Person to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a 1st-level spell. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. Make one humanoid regard you as a trusted friend and ally.

options.name: Divine Favor
options.benefit: Add Divine Favor to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a 1st-level spell. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. Gain a luck bonus on attack and weapon damage rolls.

options.name: Expeditious Retreat
options.benefit: Add Expeditious Retreat to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a 1st-level spell. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. Your base land speed increases by 30 ft.

options.name: Mage Armor
options.benefit: Add Mage Armor to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a 1st-level spell. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. Grant an armor bonus without physical armor.

options.name: Magic Missile
options.benefit: Add Magic Missile to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a 1st-level spell. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. Create force missiles that strike targets automatically.

options.name: Ray of Enfeeblement
options.benefit: Add Ray of Enfeeblement to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a 1st-level spell. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. Ray causes 1d6 Str penalty + 1 per 2 levels.

options.name: Shield
options.benefit: Add Shield to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a 1st-level spell. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. Create an invisible force barrier that grants a shield bonus to AC.

options.name: Shield of Faith
options.benefit: Add Shield of Faith to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a 1st-level spell. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. Surround the target with a deflection ward that grants a scaling bonus to Armor Class.

options.name: Silent Image
options.benefit: Add Silent Image to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a 1st-level spell. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. Creates minor illusion of your design.

options.name: True Strike
options.benefit: Add True Strike to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a 1st-level spell. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. +20 on your next attack roll.

options.name: Acid Arrow
options.benefit: Add Acid Arrow to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a 2nd-level spell. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. Ranged touch attack; 2d4 damage for 1 round + 1 round/three levels.

options.name: Detect Thoughts
options.benefit: Add Detect Thoughts to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a 2nd-level spell. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. Allows “listening” to surface thoughts.

options.name: Invisibility
options.benefit: Add Invisibility to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a 2nd-level spell. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. Subject is invisible for 1 min./level or until it attacks.

options.name: Mirror Image
options.benefit: Add Mirror Image to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a 2nd-level spell. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. Creates decoy duplicates of you (1d4 + 1 per three levels, max 8).

options.name: Scorching Ray
options.benefit: Add Scorching Ray to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a 2nd-level spell. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. Ranged touch attack deals 4d6 fire damage, + 1 ray/four levels (max 3).

options.name: See Invisibility
options.benefit: Add See Invisibility to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a 2nd-level spell. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. Reveals invisible creatures or objects.

options.name: Dispel Magic
options.benefit: Add Dispel Magic to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a 3rd-level spell. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. Cancels one magical spell or effect.

options.name: Displacement
options.benefit: Add Displacement to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a 3rd-level spell. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. Attacks miss subject 50% of the time.

options.name: Fireball
options.benefit: Add Fireball to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a 3rd-level spell. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. 1d6 damage per level, 20-ft. radius.

options.name: Lightning Bolt
options.benefit: Add Lightning Bolt to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a 3rd-level spell. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. Electricity deals 1d6/level damage.

options.name: Suggestion
options.benefit: Add Suggestion to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a 3rd-level spell. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. Compels subject to follow stated course of action.

options.name: Divine Power
options.benefit: Add Divine Power to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a 4th-level spell. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. Gain a luck bonus on attacks, weapon damage, and Strength checks plus temporary hit points and an extra attack.

options.name: Invisibility, Greater
options.benefit: Add Invisibility, Greater to the Naga Aspirant's Druid spell list as a 4th-level spell. This grants spell-list access but does not prepare the spell automatically. As invisibility, but subject can attack and stay invisible.

options.name: Charming Gaze
options.benefit: Gain a 30-foot gaze attack that functions as charm person.

options.name: Darkvision
options.benefit: Gain darkvision 60 feet in naga form.

options.name: Detect Thoughts
options.benefit: Use detect thoughts at will in naga form.

options.name: Guarded Thoughts
options.benefit: Gain +2 racial saves against charm and immunity to mind reading in naga form.

options.name: Poison Immunity
options.benefit: Gain immunity to poison; requires a poison-based natural attack.

options.name: Poisonous Sting
options.benefit: Make an existing sting venomous; requires the Sting augmentation.

options.name: Spit Venom
options.benefit: Spit bite venom as a ranged touch attack to 30 feet; requires Venomous Bite.

options.name: Sting
options.benefit: Grow a tail stinger that deals 1d6 piercing damage.

options.name: Swim
options.benefit: Gain a swim speed equal to base land speed in naga form.

options.name: Tough Scales
options.benefit: Increase naga-form natural armor by +2; this choice can be selected repeatedly and stacks.

options.name: Venomous Bite
options.benefit: The naga-form bite delivers Constitution-damaging venom.
